Card Q&A.q: After this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect activates, can I choose to not attack with my Digimon for this card's [All Turns] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [SoC] or [SEEKERS] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
[All Turns] When Tamer cards are placed in this Digimon's digivolution cards, activate 1 of this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack a player.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are deleted, if this Digimon has [Fenriloogamon] in its name, trash your opponent's top security card.
